goal: Is ke baad aap tab while loop likh sakenge jab pehle se pata na ho ke kitni dafa repeat karna hai, stop value tak input parh sakenge, number ke digits ke saath kaam kar sakenge, aur infinite loop pehchan sakenge.
warmup: Canteen ki cashier aap ki tray se items uthati rehti hai jab tak tray khali na ho jaye. Usey pehle se nahi pata ke aap ne do items khareede ya das. Woh bas wahi sawal baar baar poochti hai: 'Tray mein kuch baaki hai?' Jab tak jawab haan hai, woh ek aur item scan karti hai. Aik aur misaal: aap mobile load daalte rehte hain jab tak balance Rs 100 tak na pahunch jaye. Rounds ki tadaad data par depend karti hai, kisi fixed ginti par nahi.
definition: While loop apni body ko tab tak repeat karta hai jab tak us ki condition true ho. Condition har round se PEHLE check hoti hai, is liye is loop ko pre-test (entry-controlled) loop kehte hain, aur body zero dafa bhi run ho sakti hai. While tab use karein jab repetitions ki tadaad pehle se maloom na ho aur data par depend karti ho, jaise user ka input ya number mein bache hue digits.
howItWorks: Pipeline ko follow karein. Check pehle aata hai. Agar condition true ho to body run hoti hai, phir program dobara check karta hai. For loop ke bar-aks, while loop mein built-in update nahi hota. Aap ko initialisation loop se PEHLE (int i = 1;) aur update body ke ANDAR (i++) likhna hoga. Agar aap update bhool jayein to condition kabhi false nahi hoti aur loop hamesha chalta rehta hai. Isey infinite loop kehte hain. Console mein isey rokne ke liye Ctrl + C dabayein. Do classic istemal: (1) sentinel loop: ek number parhein, aur tab tak process karte rahein jab tak user -1 jaisi khaas value (sentinel) na likhe. Loop se pehle ek dafa parhein aur body ke end mein dobara parhein. (2) digits: num % 10 aakhri digit deta hai aur num /= 10 usey hata deta hai, is liye while (num > 0) har digit tak pahunch jata hai.
